title: Serial Check Scammer Exposed Trying to Pull Another Fraud
description:
On June 29th, 2022. Multiple bank employees called about a man who thought he could get away with cashing a fraudulent check. According to the employees, the man had been to that location multiple times trying to do the same fraud.
